datasets.title: Registers to extract
datasets.description: Convictions = the prosecutions/fines register. Notices = Improvement/Prohibition enforcement notices. Both are independent HSE registers with different fields and are pulled newest-first.

fetchBreachDetail.title: Fetch per-breach legislation detail
fetchBreachDetail.description: When enabled (default), fetches each breach's own page (or, for notices, the breach list) for the court, Act/Regulation section, hearing date and per-breach fine. Disable for a faster run with only the case/notice-level summary fields.

maxItemsPerDataset.title: Max records per register
maxItemsPerDataset.description: Hard cap on how many records to return per selected register this run (applied independently to Convictions and Notices, both sorted newest-first).
